# erp-discovery
Read AGENTS.md and relevant rules. Mine process, system, configuration, integration and history evidence. Produce typed dependency edges and coverage gaps. Ask only unresolved consequential questions. Never infer absence.
## Evidence
Record source, environment, exact revision, unknowns, validation results and proof level. Stop when any applicable gate is missing. Use deterministic tests rather than model confidence.
